blurb: DanceWell offers social dance classes and private lessons in ballroom, Latin, swing, and more for all levels. They provide a structured dance instructor training program covering 17 dances with both lead and follow roles. They also support participation in DanceSport competitions and host social dance parties.
extraNote: No refunds or credits for no-shows or late cancellations of prepaid classes or events · Prepaid series are non-refundable and non-transferable once the month begins · 3-month minimum commitment for monthly prepaid classes; 14 days written notice to cancel after · 24-hour advance notice required to reschedule or cancel private lessons; missed lessons may be charged
